<!-- For vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md. Do not include credentials or private recordings. -->

## Problem

Describe what happened and what you expected.

## Reproduction

List the steps and inputs needed to reproduce the problem.

## Environment

Include the commit, operating system, browser, and relevant service versions.

## Evidence

Include redacted logs or screenshots, checks performed, relevant failed attempts, and retries. For latency, identify the audio sample, output type (original or translated), language, partial/final state, and start/end measurement points. Distinguish provider timing, Node receipt or publication, and browser display.
